description.value:
The Guardian is a Force half-caster who wades into melee behind a blade and a wall of conviction, protecting the weak and standing against the dark (or, for those who walk a darker path themselves, imposing their own will by force). Equal parts front-line combatant and battlefield protector, the Guardian supplements martial prowess with Force powers that shield allies, smite enemies, and bind a fight to their terms.

As a Guardian's connection to the Force deepens, they radiate protective and empowering Auras that reinforce everyone fighting at their side, turning a lone knight into the anchor an entire squad rallies around.
